response.justification: The candidate lacks direct experience with C++ or Rust in geospatial routing pipelines, despite having broad full-stack exposure; their work in GIS is open-source and non-commercial, with no evidence of routing tile optimization, real-time traffic integration, or distributed systems for navigation data at scale, which are core to the role.
strengths: Extensive open-source GIS project experience with geospatial data handling
Proven ability to work across diverse tech stacks and learn new languages
Strong track record in testing, CI/CD, and developer tooling
concerns: No commercial C++ or Rust experience in routing or navigation systems
Lacks demonstrated expertise in distributed systems, fault tolerance, or routing tile pipelines
Geospatial work is primarily non-production, NGO-focused, and not performance-optimized
